parts.problem_md:
An island’s entire population of a butterfly species is descended from just two parents that were introduced from the mainland.

Which of the following statements about this butterfly population, compared with that of the mainland, is correct?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****B ****(the population will adapt more slowly to environmental changes) because:**

- The whole population has descended from just two parents, this will mean the population has very little (genetic)** variation**
- Reduced variation** **in a population means that they are less likely to adapt to any changes in the environment; this is because natural selection only occurs when there is variation present

The other answers are incorrect because all of these statements refer to a population that has a large gene pool and a large genetic diversity.

choices.label: A
choices.text_md: The population shows more genetic variety.

choices.label: B
choices.text_md: The population will adapt more slowly to environmental changes.

choices.label: C
choices.text_md: The population shows more phenotypic variation.

choices.label: D
choices.text_md: The population is less in danger of collapsing from disease.

parts.problem_md:
Which row best describes the variation seen in human blood groups?

|   | has no intermediates | shows continuous variation | shows discontinuous variation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | ✓ | X | ✓ |
| **B** | ✓ | ✓ | X |
| **C** | X | ✓ | X |
| **D** | X | X | ✓ |
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****A ****because:**

- There are therefore 4 possible phenotypes for blood type (A, B, AB and O) with **no intermediate groups**
- Blood groups, therefore, show **discontinuous variation** - there are distinct blood group categories and a person will fit into one of them

**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****D**** (a change in a gene) because:**

- The definition of a mutation is the change in the base sequence of DNA (which is a more detailed way of saying a change in a gene)
- This is how we get different versions of the same genes known as **alleles**
- **Mutations ** are the basis of **genetic variation**

**A** is incorrect because **genetic engineering** is a process that involves inserting a **gene** into an organism (from another)

**B** is incorrect because **continuous variation** is a type of variation that has a range of **phenotypes** often due to both genetic and environmental factors.

**C** is incorrect because a** dominant allele** is a version of a gene that will always be expressed in the **phenotype** of an organism.

choices.label: A
choices.text_md: A process used in genetic engineering.

choices.label: C
choices.text_md: A condition caused by a dominant allele.

parts.problem_md: Which of the following is **not **a feature of natural selection?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****B**** (selection by humans) because:**

- Within populations there will always be **variation**
- Natural selection is the ‘favouring’ of a characteristic giving an individual a survival advantage over others: individuals with these characteristics are better adapted to the **environment** (remember the environment determines what is ‘favoured’ or ‘selected’) and therefore these individuals are more likely to **survive** and **reproduce**
- Variation increases the capability of a **population **to survive and cope with environmental change
- **Artificial selection** is carried out by humans selecting specific traits and deciding which individuals in a population (of livestock animals or plant crops) are able to breed. This is not a feature of natural selection

All the other answers are incorrect because they are features of natural selection:

- Production of a large number of offspring will mean that there will be a larger range of phenotypes from the inheritance of random mutations in sexually reproducing organisms
- Competition for resources means that only the best suited to the environment are likely to survive
- Variation in the population means that there are a wide variety of genotypes and therefore phenotypes; making the population as a whole better able to adapt to changes in the environment

parts.problem_md:
**Extended Tier Only**

A patient with a bacterial infection is treated with antibiotics, but some of the bacteria survive.

Which statement about the surviving bacteria is correct?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****C**** because:**

The bacteria have survived due to the presence of an allele that provides resistance to the particular antibiotic with which they have been treated.

**A** is incorrect because** **this bacteria will not be resistant to *all* different types of antibiotic; different antibiotic kill bacteria differently, so an allele that provides resistance to one mechanism, e.g. cell wall damage, will not work against another, e.g. prevention of reproduction.

**B** is incorrect because **selective** **breeding** involves breeding individuals with desired characteristics together. These characteristics are chosen by humans.

**D** is incorrect because the next generation will now have more individuals that have resistance to the antibiotic, so the antibiotic will be less effective.

choices.label: A
choices.text_md: The bacteria have an allele that provides resistance to all antibiotics.

choices.label: B
choices.text_md: The bacteria are the result of selective breeding.

choices.label: C
choices.text_md: The bacteria have an allele that provides resistance to the antibiotic used.

choices.label: D
choices.text_md: The offspring of the bacteria will be more susceptible to the antibiotic.

parts.problem_md:
The graph below shows the height of bean plants grown from 1000 bean seeds.

![variation-graph](assets/001-variation-graph.png)

What type of variation do the plants show?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****D**** because:**

- The height of the plant is a **continuous** characteristic, meaning that it is measured on a continuous scale; this can be seen in the graph by the presence of** intermediate values** for height within each group of beans, and by the presence of bell-shaped curves.
- The graph shows **two** **distinct** groups of beans; a short group and a tall group with no overlap between the groups. Variation that can be placed into distinct groups in this way is **discontinuous**.

Make sure that you really look at the graph; it is easy to miss that there are two distinct groups of beans.

Note that** continuous variation** should ideally be represented in a graph using **bars that are touching each other**; the graph here is imperfect in this respect.

parts.problem_md:
When growing millet, farmers choose seeds from high-yielding plants.

Which of the following is this an example of?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****C**** (artificial selection) because:**

- Selecting plants for their desirable characteristics is **selective breeding**
- This is **artificial selection** carried out by humans

**A** is incorrect because **evolution** is the change in adaptive features of a population over time as the result of **natural selection**.

**B** is incorrect because **adaptations** are an inherited feature that help an organism to survive and reproduce in its environment.

**D** is incorrect because **natural selection** is the process by which organisms best suited to their environment (better adapted) are more likely to survive and reproduce.

parts.problem_md: Which of the following characteristics shows discontinuous variation?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is ****C**** (tongue rolling) because:**

A characteristic that shows discontinuous variation is usually determined by **genetic** differences only (the environment does not influence the characteristic). Tongue-rolling has a limited number of phenotypes with no variation in between (intermediates) - you can either roll your tongue or you can’t.

**A**, **B** and **D** are all incorrect because they are all examples of continuous variation. Continuous variation results in a wider range of phenotypes, often seen as a bell shaped curve on a graph. They have a wide range of variations in between (intermediates).
